cases.title: Charge Balance
cases.classification: Mixed: ten exact encoded charge discrepancies and one floating-point false positive
cases.observed: Raw MEMOTE flags 11 of 843 assessed reactions. Exact-decimal charge residuals are PFOR +1, CYP460ipp +2, ACCOAC_1 -1, BTNC +1, MC_Average_FattyAcid -0.001, HAORipp +2, APG3PAT_MCi +0.001, ASNTRAT +1, POR_syn -2 and G3PAT_MCi +0.001. MC_AFAA is exactly balanced; its -4.44e-16 floating residual is numerical. All metabolites have charges assigned.
cases.biological_meaning: These flags concern the consistency of encoded chemistry rather than missing metadata. Redox-carrier electron counts and charged carrier/pseudo-lipid conventions can alter proton coupling, nutrient oxidation and predicted yields. Four affected reactions are disabled by baseline bounds [0,0] (ACCOAC_1, BTNC, HAORipp, ASNTRAT); their errors are latent until a variant enables them. The remaining exact discrepancies can affect allowed fluxes. Apart from the average-fatty-acid defect, the flagged equations are element balanced, so adding/removing H+ alone would introduce atom errors.
cases.suggested_improvement: Audit shared carrier definitions and reaction evidence in groups: PFOR/POR_syn redox carriers; CYP460ipp/HAORipp products and cytochrome electron counts; ACCOAC_1/BTNC modified biotin; ASNTRAT aminoacyl-tRNA; and the full scaled lipid network. Specify a consistent protonation convention and distinguish true electron transfer from proton changes. Keep MC_AFAA as a numerical-only raw flag. Do not silently patch proton coefficients or broaden the tolerance until the exact ±0.001 lipid errors disappear from view.
cases.acceptance: Each revised reaction preserves both atoms and charge under a stated chemical convention, changes to shared metabolite definitions are checked across every incident reaction, and literature supports carrier capacity/product identity. Recheck energy-generating cycles and medium-specific predictions after any accepted change. Report both the original MEMOTE result and the supplementary numerical classification.
evidence: reports/baseline-audit/memote-results.json supplies all 11 IDs; decimal residuals and complete equations/formulas/charges are recorded in chemistry-details.json.
CYP460ipp/HAORipp reduce two +3 ferricytochromes to +2 while converting hydroxylamine to nitrite; the encoded substrate/product conversion is a four-electron oxidation, giving the +2 discrepancy.

The biotin-carrier pair has opposite charge residuals; both carrier states are encoded charge 0. The two glycerol-phosphate acyltransferases use a scaled acyl-CoA charge -3001 with coefficient 0.001, leaving exact +0.001.
Notebook 8 formula_changer sets charge using integer conversion after rescaling; this motivates a network-wide pseudo-unit review rather than treating the lipid residuals as floating-point noise.

cases.title: Mass Balance
cases.classification: Mixed: one large genuine pseudo-metabolite unit defect and six exact-zero floating-point false positives
cases.observed: Raw MEMOTE flags 7 of 843 assessed non-boundary/non-biomass reactions. Decimal recomputation shows six have exactly zero elemental residual; their floating residuals are at most 7.11e-15. MC_Average_FattyAcid instead has exact product-minus-reactant residuals C +16024.959, H +31023.945 and O +1996.002. This is not caused by absent formulas.
cases.biological_meaning: The average-fatty-acid product retains coefficient 1 after its formula was expanded from a one-unit average to C16041H31055O1998, an integer representation 1000 times the weighted composition. The weighted inputs supply C16.041H31.055O1.998 (255.9320 g/mol on that averaging basis), whereas one product pseudo-unit weighs 255932.0166 g/mol. Downstream pseudo-lipid stoichiometry and biomass lipid coefficients are divided by 1000. This breaks elemental accounting and materially changes predicted growth/yields. A feasible S·v=0 solution or positive-mass stoichiometric consistency result does not validate the assigned chemical formulas.
cases.suggested_improvement: Preserve the seven raw flags, but supplement them with an explicit numerical-tolerance or decimal audit so six numerical residuals do not trigger chemistry edits. For the real defect, review the original fatty-acid distribution and choose a single consistent pseudo-unit representation, propagating atom counts, charges and coefficients through every linked reaction and biomass. Separately resolve the 0.999 reactant-weight sum from rounding; do not conflate that 0.1% issue with the factor-1000 error. Treat any isolated coefficient change as a diagnostic until the whole representation passes conservation and phenotype checks.
cases.acceptance: A reviewed variant has consistent units across synthesis, activation, phospholipid synthesis and biomass; atom and charge balances meet a declared tight tolerance (or exact finite-decimal equality); mixture proportions have source provenance; all affected bounds/units are assessed if reaction scaling changes; and yields are revalidated.
